TITLE: FormFix Postpartum
ACTIVITY: Postpartum core/pelvic-floor rehab (diastasis recti, leaks) — ~3.6M US births/yr plus years-long tails; the majority of mothers have diastasis or pelvic-floor symptoms and do daily 5-15 min rehab sessions.
CLAIM: A camera-based form coach for postpartum core work: the VLM watches you do deep-core/pelvic exercises and corrects form in real time ("your belly is doming — that's making it worse, draw the ribs down," "you're holding your breath, exhale on the effort"), the exact thing that determines whether these exercises heal or worsen separation.
NOVELTY: Found many strong VIDEO-PROGRAM apps (Every Mother — clinically validated; Birth Recovery Center; DiastaFix; Pelvic Floor & Core Coach; RCT-validated JustFit) — but every one delivers one-way follow-along videos/text, with NO computer-vision feedback on form. The only real-time form product found is RecoverTrack, a $299 hardware wearable. No phone-camera, software-only form-correction app exists. Open wedge confirmed.
USERBASE_SCORE: 7 — very large recurring cohort, daily during recovery window, but time-boxed life stage caps lifetime frequency.
NOVELTY_SCORE: 8 — content programs are crowded; vision-based form correction is empty in software.
MECHANISM: On-device pose + VLM detects abdominal doming, breath-hold, pelvic tilt, compensation patterns from the front camera and gives spoken cues; flags exercises to stop. Newly possible: VLMs can read subtle soft-tissue cues (doming) beyond skeletal pose. Cost bounded; pose work runs on-device, VLM only on ambiguous frames.
GROWTH_MONETIZATION: OB/pelvic-PT and "mom influencer" referral; "I finally closed my gap" before/after is shareable. ~$15-25/mo (clinical-adjacent WTP high, per DiastaFix's $24.99). $1-5M at 8-15k subs given high ARPU. Potential B2B to PT clinics/insurers.
RISKS: (1) Health/medical-claims and liability scrutiny; must stay "wellness, consult your provider." (2) Vision reliability for soft-tissue doming harder than skeletal pose. (3) Every Mother (validated, funded) or a wearable maker could add camera feedback.
